items.understanding: The narrator says modern people are deeply unsatisfied because no frontiers remain, then asks whether this resonates with a founder in 2026.
items.cause: There are no frontiers left (only trivial or impossible tasks remain).
items.asserted: Modern people are deeply unsatisfied because there are no frontiers left.

notAsserted.text: Doesn't that ring true for a founder in 2026?
notAsserted.why: It is a rhetorical question to the listener, not a stated fact.

keyFacts: the point is put to a founder in 2026
wrong: Frontiers disappeared because people became unsatisfied (reversed cause and effect).
